# Charging pilot: working notes

These notes record how the first two streets were chosen, and what the engineers would change.

## Choosing the streets

We counted homes without a driveway on every street in the east side, then ranked the streets by that count. The top two became the pilot.

- Count homes with no off-street parking
- Rank streets by that count
- Check the lamp posts can carry a metered socket

> Every third lamp post first, and more only where the sockets fill up.

## What the first year showed

| Measure | Kerbside | Rapid |
|---|---|---|
| Energy per unit (kWh a day) | 38 | 31 |
| Average session | 9 hours | 40 minutes |
| Share of users with no driveway | 81% | 12% |

## Open questions

1. How do we reopen the lamp post contracts without a vote for each one?
2. Who pays when a cable is left out in the road?
3. Can the monthly figures be published as a dataset?

---

*Written by the transport office. Figures are from the year-one report.*
